description: Mainnet accounts, programs and transactions dumped for the program tests (ARCHITECTURE §1.2, §8.2). Each entry records how it was fetched; SHA256SUMS pins the bytes (CI: cd tests/fixtures && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS). The Raydium entries (groups raydium_programs and raydium_state), the pump entries (groups pump_programs and pump_state) and the PumpSwap entries (group pamm_state, and pamm_synthetic: pools derived offline from pamm_state bytes, marked `synthetic`) and the M10 program groups (raydium_cpmm_2026_10: the CPMM redeploy; spl_programs: the mainnet Token-2022 and spl-memo; squads_programs: Squads v4, its ProgramConfig and the vendored IDL; pump_programs_2026_10: the pump, pump-fees and PumpSwap redeploys of 2026-10-02; pump_programs_2026_10_13: those of 2026-10-08/12; pump_programs_2026_10_13b: pump's of 2026-10-13) and the state those introduced (group pump_state_2026_10_13) are written by scripts/dump-fixtures.py; `snapshots` records the slot and RPC of each group (`vendored`: files taken from a pinned source).
